items.trigger: Session storage, config schema, or persisted state fields are modified
items.check: Verify that newly added fields have safe defaults when loading older persisted files produced by previous versions.
items.history: Example rule inspired by real backward-compatibility incidents

items.trigger: Database migrations, job retries, or webhook handlers are modified
items.check: Confirm executing the same operation twice produces the exact same end state without duplicate side effects.
items.history: Prevents duplicate writes during network retries

items.trigger: Logging, telemetry, or error formatting logic is changed
items.check: Ensure API keys, auth headers, tokens, and PII are redacted before writing to stdout or log files.
items.history: Prevents credential exposure in CI or production logs
